subject.title: [Bug] Feishu plugin 2026.5.22: gateway connection timeout + QR code display broken

question: Should Feishu startup keep the current 30s bot-identity probe before WebSocket startup, or should the plugin hand off faster and recover bot identity in the background?
rationale: The remaining behavior is not a mechanical QR rendering fix; it changes how Feishu auth/identity readiness is traded against prompt channel startup and mention-gating reliability.

options.title: Fast handoff with recovery
options.body: Start the Feishu transport promptly, keep bot identity recovery in the background, and require live Windows Feishu proof that messages and mention-gated groups behave correctly.

options.title: Keep current probe
options.body: Keep the 30s pre-transport probe as intentional safety, improve user-facing logs/docs, and close only after maintainers accept the startup delay tradeoff.

options.title: Split remaining work
options.body: Close the QR portion after a release contains https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97087 and move startup timing to a narrower Feishu startup issue.

recommendation.title: Fast handoff with recovery
recommendation.body: Start the Feishu transport promptly, keep bot identity recovery in the background, and require live Windows Feishu proof that messages and mention-gated groups behave correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the declared Feishu plugin community-maintained contact and were already pulled into this issue's timeline.
